verdict.rationale: Exa documents its own search API that takes natural-language queries over a self-built index, with search types ranging from instant to deep-reasoning (exa-docs-22, exa-docs-18, exa-probe-1). Community users are impressed with the search API and contrast it with SERP-style keyword results (exa-comm-1, exa-comm-8). However, no evidence explicitly describes embedding- or meaning-based retrieval, and one hands-on report found only about 30/70 accuracy in repo search (exa-comm-4). missing for 10: explicit documentation of semantic/neural retrieval, evidence or benchmarks showing it finds results keyword engines miss, consistent hands-on recall corroboration.
